# `BalanceSensor`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Tilt/accelerometer sample with a validity code, sent from the 100 ms sensor timer when it changes.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, sendSensorData @0x132ca0, packBalanceSensorData @0x1261a0, RefreshPiTemp thread @0x137790 (timer @0x13785c, teardown @0x1379cc) (64-bit build) |

Broadcast on TCP 4700 (channel I) from the sensor sampling timer, which is initialized with a 100 ms initial and repeat interval. A try-lock and processing guards can skip ticks, and only selected changed or valid balance branches send, so 100 ms is not a guarantee of 10 events per second. The stream is not client-controlled: a background housekeeping thread of the imager enables the g-sensor and arms the timer when it starts, and deletes the timer when it exits (READ; that it runs for the life of the imager is INFERRED). No method starts or stops it. code is 0 for a valid reading and 1 when the sensor could not be read, in which case x, y, z and angle are zero. On the 64-bit build the first valid sample is sent; later samples are sent only when angle (tilt from vertical, degrees) differs from the last sent value by more than 0.26 and the 2-degree level lies between the two; a failed read is sent once (READ; 32-bit not checked). The packer is the same as for the balance_sensor member of get_device_state. code is an embedded status, not an RPC error code; there is no state member. Family: custom. APK consumers: the app event dispatcher (balance sensor DTO) and the app device service sensor consumers. The APK compass-sensor DTO is a separate consumer type, not something this packer emits.

Side effects: Observation only.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"BalanceSensor"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string with nine fractional digits from a monotonic clock; not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `code` | integer | yes | - | Validity of the reading, the inverse of the packer's valid flag. 0 valid reading; 1 the sensor could not be read (data members then zero). One of: `0`, `1`. [READ] |
| `data` | object | yes | - | Always packed. [READ] |
| `data.x` | number | yes | - | Sensor x component; scaling unresolved. [READ; unit unresolved] |
| `data.y` | number | yes | - | Sensor y component; scaling unresolved. [READ; unit unresolved] |
| `data.z` | number | yes | - | Sensor z component; scaling unresolved. [READ; unit unresolved] |
| `data.angle` | number | yes | - | Tilt angle in degrees, computed by the producer from the axis components. [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, sample - READ shape, not captured; values invented:

```json
{"Event":"BalanceSensor","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","code":0,"data":{"x":0.02,"y":-0.01,"z":0.99,"angle":1.3}}
```
